examples.question: How many singers do we have?

examples.question: What are the names , themes , and number of singers for every concert ?
examples.gold: select t2.concert_name ,  t2.theme ,  count(*) from singer_in_concert as t1 join concert as t2 on t1.concert_id  =  t2.concert_id group by t2.concert_id
examples.raw: select t2.concert_name ,  t2.theme ,  count(*) from singer_in_concert as t1 join concert as t2 on t1.concert_id  =  t2.concert_id group by t2.concert_id

examples.question: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
examples.gold: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
examples.raw: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
